_note: Hand-computed from the case timelines in cases.py (contract 10.1 E01 and 7.4), not from the scorer. Seconds; T0 = 2026-10-19T06:00:00.000Z = 1792389600000 ms.

b1_recovered.label: RECOVERED
b1_recovered.why: mttd = detect 131 - effect 101; mttr = T_rec 191 - detect 131; total = 191 - 101; reaction = SUCCESS 150 - detect 131

bm_manual.label: RECOVERED
bm_manual.why: same timeline; the operator decision is the action source

bm_autoheal.label: MISSING
bm_autoheal.why: an automatic RULES decision behind a BM action is auto-heal in MANUAL (contract 7.4)

b0_controller.label: RECOVERED_UNDETECTED
b0_controller.why: no ZERO DOOR detector/decider: MTTD/MTTR/reaction are N/A, never 0; TotalRecovery from effect = 191 - 101

b0_with_decision.label: MISSING
b0_with_decision.why: DECISION, HEAL_STARTED, API_ACCEPTED, ACTION_COMPLETED are forbidden in B0

b1_failed_timeout.label: TIMEOUT
b1_failed_timeout.why: action FAILED, probe fails from 101 to 260 and covers T_eff + cap_rec = 101 + 120 = 221: TIMEOUT; no MTTR (empty, not 0)

b1_clock_unverified.label: MISSING
b1_clock_unverified.why: probe clock without CLOCK_SYNC: effect/recovery cannot be compared with the host-clock detect

b1_empty.why: no attack: N = 0 is EMPTY, never PASS and never a rate of 0 or 100%
